diagnosis: The authentication middleware contains an algorithm confusion vulnerability by falling back to HMAC token verification using the public RSA key as the symmetric secret. An attacker can craft a JWT with alg HS256 signed with the publicly accessible RSA public key, forging arbitrary claims and gaining unauthorized access to /api/organizations/:orgId/financial-records.
